data.name: Madhumathi
data.gender_notes: Madhumathi is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Madhu: Honey, Nectar, Sweetness; Mati: Intelligence, Wisdom. This name symbolizes a wise and intelligent woman, as sweet as honey. The name Madhumathi carries the meaning “Honey or Sweet” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Madhumathi usually hope their child will grow to embody honey or sweet and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the divine nectar of knowledge and wisdom.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Madhumathi total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
